name: toe walk
description: Walking on the balls of your feet with heels lifted. It works the calves and the small stabilisers of the feet and ankles.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted as high as you comfortably can.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your core tight and your gaze forward.
Walk for 20-30 steps, rest, and repeat.
